description: This file defines the BugsParseRule class, which extends BaseRule and implements a preParse method to modify panel data structures for specific view types in the SugarCRM SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: BugsParseRule
classes.description: A parser rule class for handling bug-related panel modifications in SuiteCRM, particularly for 'DetailView' rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the BugsParseRule class. Currently does not perform any initialization.

methods.name: preParse
methods.description: Processes panels data before rendering; modifies the panels array by replacing certain panel entries with 'found_in_release' when conditions match, specifically for the 'DetailView' view.
